user.title: IntellegyHUB
user.description: Connect to the IntellegyHUB add-on backend. The integration tries to detect the installed add-on automatically; use this field only if automatic detection could not reach the backend.

data_description.url: Manual fallback. For local installs use http://local-intellegyhub:8098. For repository installs use the add-on slug with underscores replaced by dashes, for example http://a11dcbe3-intellegyhub:8098.
